philosophy.wilderness_and_postgame: retain default Cobbleverse pools; add low-weight place signatures

evolution_policy.rule: A table lists families by the species first met there; the generator walks the Cobblemon jar's evolutions forward. A stage spawns from the level it evolves at (or the band's floor) to four past its next level evolution (or the band's top), and not at all if that range is empty. maturity[tier] of a family's weight goes to its evolved stages, the final one taking (tier - 3) / 6 of it, held to [0.2, 0.9]. Evolutions not by level appear only from tier 6 (a trade from tier 7), in the upper half of the band.
evolution_policy.retired: 2026-10-02: the band-minimum rule (level evolutions only when every threshold is at or below the band minimum; special evolutions authored-only) and its fixed stage splits.

marine_zones.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions windward_deep: its landmass stretch (z2592-5200, x to 984; the south edge taken to z5215, the end of the 32-block cell row the zone boundary falls in, so no 16-block strip is left to the pack) and its border margin, carried on west to the world border at x-1024 across the Outer Deep's strip behind it, so no pack default is left anywhere west of Route 1 and the west shore
marine_zones.distance_measure: blocks from the nearest land sub-region cell (tools/compile_spawns.py marine_bands); the sub-region polygons were drawn to the coast, and over the 3,959 cells of this zone to z5199 that distance matches the heightmap coast distance within -20 / 0 / +41 blocks at p5 / p50 / p95 (measured 2026-09-26)
marine_zones.policy: exclusive_curated: the pack's inherited spawns are suppressed over every band box (tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py --subregions)
marine_zones.access: Open water needs a Pokemon that carries a player on water (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a player on Route 1 for the first time can't swim without a surf mon'). No data in the repo gates riding; ASSUMED from the rosters and the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar and COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31 riding data: the earliest water mounts are a rare Relicanth at Arrow Lake (10-22, before Brock), Gyarados from a lake Magikarp at level 20 (the gym 1 cap) and Kingler from the west shore's Krabby at 28; water starters' mounts come at 30-36. So a first ride falls around gym 1 to 2, cap 20 to 25, and the bands are set to caps 20, 25 and 30 outward.
marine_zones.level_logic: levels rise with distance from land, one gym cap per band: shallows 16-20 (gym 1 cap), open water 20-25 (gym 2 cap), the deep 25-30 (gym 3 cap). The cap curve is docs/story/GYM_SUFFICIENCY_AUDIT.md's recommended 20/25/30 with relativeLevelCap 0 (modpack/config/rctmod-server.toml).
marine_zones.depth: deep-water entries carry maxY 40 (22 blocks under the surface, below the shelf break at y46): in open water the seabed median is y21 and in the deep y14, so 19 to 26 blocks of water qualify. Surface entries carry canSeeSky true.

An evolution whose level is above the band's minimum is listed authored-only (weight 0), the evolution_policy's eligibility rule; the levels are the ones data/spawns.json's eligibility reasons already record. Barbaracle and Clawitzer are left out: no entry in data/spawns.json records their level

route_species_selection_note: Generated by tools/build_encounters.py from data/encounter_design.json (docs/mechanics/ENCOUNTER_DESIGN.md section 6): per route, the families in rules.corridor_roles (never rare, never a find) of every sub-region its corridor crosses (data/routes.json geography transitions), at most corridor_species_limit, every crossed table's water species kept and the rest by chance times corridor length. tools/compile_spawns.py reads this list and does not choose. Do not edit by hand.

compilation.status: historical: the record of the uncommitted one-off that produced the former data/cobblemon/ files on the pre-rescale routes. Pools are now generated by tools/compile_spawns.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_spawns/, whose manifest.json carries the current counts; the box_assignment rule below is the one that tool implements.
compilation.box_assignment: sample the simplified measured route polyline every 4 blocks; a merged box receives a separate biome-constrained entry set for every geography interval its samples cross; outer raster boxes missed by simplification use nearest-segment assignment; recorded polygon-gap samples use the nearest adjacent subregion

rift_biome_note: The four Rift sub-regions' entries are keyed to cobblers:the_rift, painted to the lip by tools/rift_skin.py. They were minecraft:windswept_gravelly_hills, which after the biome paint exists only outside the lip: leaving them would have spawned the Rift's roster on the plateau and nothing inside it (2026-09-22).
